headline: Animal Masks
tagline: Instant dress-up for little wild ones

scenes.title: Full-Color Leopard Mask
scenes.say: Thread elastic through the little side markers so it stays put during a backyard safari.

scenes.title: Color-In Sloth Mask
scenes.say: Wide, simple shapes mean even toddlers can color it without getting frustrated.

scenes.title: Full-Color Narwhal Mask
tips: Tape on a craft stick handle
Great for kids who skip elastic
scenes.say: Tape a craft stick to one side for kids who would rather hold it than wear it.

scenes.title: Rainbow Macaw Mask
tips: Glue on a few craft feathers
scenes.say: Glue a few craft feathers around the edges for an extra fluffy jungle party look.

scenes.title: Color-In Tiger Mask
scenes.say: Color it classic orange, or let kids invent a wild new tiger in their favorite colors.

scenes.title: Full-Color Panda Mask
scenes.say: Glue it onto card stock before cutting, and it holds its shape through hours of play.

scenes.title: Full-Color Ladybug Mask
scenes.say: Hand one to every guest at a bug party, then act out a favorite story together.

tips.title: Before you print
tips.say: Print on card stock for sturdier masks, and mix color-in pages with ready-to-wear ones.

say.title: Free printable animal masks for instant dress-up and pretend play.
say.hook: Just print, cut out the eyes, and add elastic at the side markers.
say.end: Download them all free at printamoo dot com.
